lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is the San Miguel County Planning Commission meeting Wednesday, where proposed amendments to the Affordable Housing Impact Mitigation Fee — the formula that shapes whether workforce housing actually gets built here — are on the table for discussion. The Open Space Commission also meets Monday to dig into the Valley Floor goat grazing pilot, with a resident pushing for hard data on vegetation, costs, and wildlife impacts. Ouray's Planning Commission takes up a proposed ordinance on natural medicine regulation Monday as well, and the KOTO Ski Swap arrives Friday if you still need gear.
